saw_lines: Dental offices buy by watching how a quote reaches the patient, so they judge the process before the price.
So the sale is won in the first line, where a clinic manager decides if the process looks simple.
Your 13 live ads are all still images, so buyers never see a quote move. Shoot three videos of a quote reaching a patient phone and test them against your oldest ad.

ads.source: Meta Ad Library, active ads, 15 Nov 2026
points: None of your 13 live ads is a video. A dental quote is a process, and still frames hide the steps. Shoot three videos of a quote reaching a patient phone and test them against your oldest ad.
3 of your 6 copy ads run one identical text, so a buyer who scrolls past one sees the same words again. Keep that body copy in one ad. Rewrite the opening line and swap the image in the other two.

None of your 13 live ads carries a proof number, so a dentist scanning the feed has nothing concrete to trust. Collect one figure you can stand behind, such as practices onboarded, and open the next three ads with it.
3 of your 6 copy ads open on the same “Du premier contact à la” line, so the feed repeats one voice. Test two new openers against it, one built on the 5 hours a week saved, one on setup.

ads_1: Quote tracking video ads with two new openers in place of the Du premier contact line
soc_1: Brand social strategy for the channels your buyers already use
